import Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite

open Set

theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {s : Set α} : ∑ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ s), 1 = s.ncard := by
  let n := s.ncard
  have h1 : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac
  have h2 : ∑ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ s), 1 = n :=
    by
      rw [SumFin.mk_eq]
      exact ⟨n, λ _, 1⟩
  exact h2
